meaning.long_meaning: Anukul corresponds to the Sanskrit form अनुकूल. Its core lexical sense is favourable, agreeable, conformable. अनुकूल (anukūla) means favourable, agreeable or conformable. The source gloss 'friendly, pleasing' is close but not the lexical sense.

faq.a: Anukul corresponds to the Sanskrit form अनुकूल, whose core lexical sense is favourable, agreeable, conformable.

faq.q: What is the origin of Anukul?
faq.a: Anukul is associated with Sanskrit. अनुकूल (anukūla) means favourable, agreeable or conformable. The source gloss 'friendly, pleasing' is close but not the lexical sense.
Yes — the underlying form अनुकूल is Sanskrit.
Anukul is used in Hindu naming practice, but Sanskrit origin alone does not make a name Hindu. The classification here rests on documented naming usage.
